quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026, consolidated, K-IFRS; reviewer changed from EY Hanyoung to Samil PwC for FY2026): revenue KRW 41,880M vs KRW 24,340M in H1 2025 (+72.1%); gross profit KRW 2,142M (5.1% GM, vs a KRW 5,435M gross LOSS a year ago); operating LOSS KRW 3,578M vs KRW 11,156M loss; net loss KRW 810M vs KRW 9,713M; basic EPS -KRW 69 vs -837. Q2 ALONE turned profitable: revenue KRW 21,310M (+133% YoY vs KRW 9,139M; +3.6% QoQ vs KRW 20,570M in Q1), operating profit KRW 328M (vs -KRW 4,730M in Q2 2025 and -KRW 3,906M in Q1 2026), net income KRW 729M (EPS KRW 62), helped by a KRW 5,953M derivative valuation gain on the convertible bond offset by a KRW 5,147M valuation loss. MIX (H1): product sales KRW 38,615M = 92.2% -- AUTOMOTIVE KRW 23,090M (55.13%), AI KRW 12,827M (30.63%), security KRW 1,204M, IoT KRW 674M, display KRW 581M, IP development KRW 238M; design services KRW 3,265M (7.8%). AI share fell from 50.7% (FY2024) and 40.3% (FY2025) as automotive rose from 22.0% to 55.1%. By recognition: prototype development (over time) KRW 28,094M, product supply (point in time) KRW 10,521M, services KRW 3,265M. GEOGRAPHY: domestic KRW 30,992M (74.0%), overseas KRW 10,887M (26.0%; Q2 overseas KRW 5,299M); product exports KRW 9,625M, service exports KRW 1,263M. Balance sheet at 2026-06-30: cash KRW 36,455M + short-term deposits KRW 22,708M; Shinhan Bank term loans KRW 4,825M (2.27-2.39%, due 2028-10-22); zero-coupon convertible bond (issued 2025-04-03, KRW 34,500M, conversion price KRW 43,410) partly converted on 2026-04-17 (KRW 10,350M into 238,424 shares) leaving KRW 24,150M face; debt-to-equity 132.8% vs 191.3% at year-end; operating cash flow +KRW 4,286M vs -KRW 26,820M in H1 2025. Consolidated subsidiaries: GAONCHIPS JAPAN (Tokyo), GAONCHIPS AMERICA (San Jose), GAONCHIPS CHINA (Shanghai FTZ, newly established 2026-02-13). Headcount 278 at 2026-06-30, 238 (86%) in R&D/engineering; R&D expense KRW 1,146M (2.74% of revenue).

quarterly_data.signal: Orders and customers (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026, as of 2026-06-30). Disclosed design-contract book: 5 contracts in progress totalling KRW 151,279M signed, KRW 74,866M recognised to date, ORDER BACKLOG KRW 76,412M (up from KRW 50.3B at 2026-03-31 after a new win). Contract by contract (section XI, counterparties anonymised A-E): (1) AI SEMICONDUCTOR ASIC design/development with customer A, USD 42,000,000 = KRW 59,740M, signed 2024-02-08, ends 2026-08-31, KRW 56,400M recognised (94.4%), KRW 59,277M cash received, KRW 3,339M remaining; (2) custom ASIC design with customer B, USD 7,023,417 = KRW 9,753M, signed 2025-09-15, ends 2027-06-30, 0% progress, KRW 9,753M fully prepaid; (3) custom ASIC design with customer C, KRW 33,902M, signed 2025-10-29, ends 2028-07-31, KRW 12,205M recognised (36.0%), KRW 21,697M remaining; (4) custom ASIC design with customer D, KRW 17,937M, signed 2025-12-26, ends 2026-10-01, KRW 4,635M recognised (25.8%), KRW 13,302M remaining; (5) NEW custom ASIC design with customer E disclosed 2026-06-11, USD 19,500,000 = KRW 29,947M, signed 2026-06-10, ends 2028-06-30, KRW 1,626M recognised (5.4%), KRW 7,402M collected, KRW 28,321M remaining. Contract liabilities rose to KRW 25,279M from KRW 16,793M (customer prepayments) while contract assets fell to KRW 8,303M from KRW 19,877M. CUSTOMER CONCENTRATION (H1 2026, top-5 anonymised): A KRW 15,328M (36.60%), B KRW 10,213M (24.39%), C KRW 6,584M (15.72%), D KRW 3,642M (8.70%), E KRW 1,626M (3.88%) -- top five = 89.3% of revenue (FY2025: A 32.66%, B 29.18%, C 19.36%). The parent-only related-party note books KRW 10,213M of H1 sales through GAONCHIPS JAPAN acting as sales agent -- identical to customer B's figure, i.e. the #2 customer is served via the Japan subsidiary (FY2025's #1 customer, KRW 22,378M, was likewise routed through Japan). Customers are fabless companies; sales are direct (no distributors) through domestic and overseas sales teams plus the Japan/US/China subsidiaries; Europe is the next planned sales-network expansion. A KRW 282M onerous-contract provision was booked in H1.

quarterly_data.signal: Supply side (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): Gaonchips owns no production assets -- wafers, packaging and test are fully outsourced to foundry and OSAT partners (names withheld as trade secrets; the company is a Samsung Foundry Design Solution Partner since 2019-07 and Arm Approved Design Partner since 2020-06, with a Synopsys IP OEM partnership since 2024-02). H1 2026 PURCHASES KRW 24,123M: outsourced FAB (wafer) processing KRW 17,757M domestic + KRW 409M imported, packaging KRW 222M, other outsourcing KRW 1,619M, and IP (the only raw material) KRW 2,220M domestic + KRW 1,896M imported -- vs FY2025 total KRW 43,809M (FAB KRW 22,368M domestic + KRW 8,978M imported, IP KRW 10,083M). Average foundry WAFER PRICE across product sales USD 3,820 per wafer in H1 2026 vs USD 4,411 in 2025 and USD 4,857 in 2024. Outsourced-processing expense in the P&L KRW 24,140M in H1 vs KRW 15,534M a year ago. Production resource is headcount: 278 staff, 238 engineers. Capex is design infrastructure, not plant: H1 intangible (EDA/software) additions KRW 4,532M plus KRW 1,072M transferred from construction-in-progress (software book value up to KRW 8,884M from KRW 4,793M), tangible additions KRW 617M; the convertible-bond proceeds earmarked KRW 14,500M for facilities have KRW 4,906M spent to date, with KRW 26,767M of CB/IPO cash still unused (KRW 15,000M in short-term deposits). Product supply modes: six wafer/bump/test/package combinations up to full turnkey delivery through foundry and OSAT partners.

quarterly_data.signal: AI / data-center positioning (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): as a Samsung Foundry DSP the company says it is developing AI chips from BIG-DIE AI accelerators for data centers and HPC on the 2nm GAA process down to next-generation edge generative-AI chips, and is strengthening mass-production support for 2.5D/3D memory-based ADVANCED PACKAGING; its turnkey offering covers HBM integration and 2.5D/3D advanced-packaging-linked design. Filing states CSPs, big-tech and OEMs are increasingly developing in-house chips to reduce dependence on specific vendors, and that the leading-edge high-end ASIC market is growing fast; AI demand is broadening from data-center training to inference, edge AI and physical AI (robots, drones). Nevertheless AI revenue was KRW 12,827M (30.6%) in H1 2026 vs KRW 27,613M (40.3%) for all of FY2025 and KRW 48,938M (50.7%) in FY2024, and the single disclosed AI-semiconductor ASIC contract (USD 42M, customer A) is 94.4% complete and ends 2026-08-31; the four newer disclosed contracts (KRW 91.5B combined) are labelled custom ASIC without an AI tag. AI/HPC and automotive together were more than 80% of FY2025 product revenue.
